Cinzel 5.3.0 (Latin subset, regular weight), from the Fontsource package @fontsource/cinzel
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource/cinzel/v/5.3.0
         https://registry.npmjs.org/@fontsource/cinzel/-/cinzel-5.3.0.tgz (published 19 July 2026)
Font:    https://github.com/NDISCOVER/Cinzel (Natanael Gama, The Cinzel Project Authors)
Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see cinzel-OFL.txt, the package's LICENSE file)

cinzel.woff is the package's files/cinzel-latin-400-normal.woff, unchanged and
renamed. The .woff is used rather than the .woff2 because opentype.js 1.3.4
(assets/vendor/opentype/) reads WOFF but not WOFF2.

The Roman Numerals Converter (/roman-numerals-converter/) turns numerals into
outlines with this font for its large preview and its PNG and SVG downloads, so
the SVG needs no font installed. Both files are loaded only when the preview
comes into view or a download is asked for.
